description: Defines the NullFeature class, representing a feature with a JSON null value in the Eclipse Ditto framework. Implements the Feature interface, providing methods to handle feature properties and their JSON representation.

classes.name: NullFeature
classes.description: An immutable class representing a feature with a JSON null value in the Ditto model.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a NullFeature instance with validation against invalid characters and slashes.

methods.name: getDefinition
methods.description: Returns an empty Optional, as NullFeature does not hold a definition.

methods.name: setDefinition
methods.description: Returns the current NullFeature instance, as immutability is enforced.

methods.name: getProperties
methods.description: Returns an empty Optional, as NullFeature does not hold properties.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Returns an empty Optional, as no properties are stored.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Returns a JSON null object representation.

methods.name: toJson (overloaded)
methods.description: Returns a JSON null object considering schema version and predicate.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on feature ID.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on class and feature ID.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the NullFeature instance.
